Update: Capital Chronicle pre-US wrap: dollar slips, oil premium fades


Capital Chronicle's pre-US review: the dollar leg is clear, gold and stocks are mixed, and CPI is the test.


What to watch: In Capital Chronicle's review, gold's range and the split stock-index tape make CPI the next test; a weaker dollar across FX is not a common six-market direction.


Read the full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/capital-chronicle-pre-us-wrap-dollar


Chart: TradingView.


Capital Chronicle's dated review provides analysis, not independently confirmed event facts or a performance record. Analysis, not financial advice. Readers decide whether to trade.


Base case: 55% weekly model estimate set Sunday; talks continue and oil fades. CPI can override the path.
Alternative: 25% weekly model estimate set Sunday; if escalation is confirmed, oil would rise and stocks weaken.


Capital Chronicle may hold positions in the markets it covers.
